Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3984; inexperienced, i.e. ignorant:--unskilful.
BiblicalUsage: Unskilful — the one who still lives on milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness, a babe rather than a grown man. The word is about inexperience, not stupidity: the skill comes with use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this as a push toward maturity: the word is meant to be practised, not just heard.
